name: otaq
description: Otaq for Codex: its agent signal hooks and Otaq's own skills.

hooks.description: Otaq agent signals: each hook passes its JSON to `otaq hook --tool codex <event>`, which does nothing unless OTAQ_TICKET is set (and nothing at all when otaq isn't installed). The command lines stay fixed: Codex trusts each hook by a hash of its config.

hooks.command: command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool codex SessionStart
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool codex PermissionRequest
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool codex Stop
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool codex Interrupt
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool codex UserPromptSubmit
